outline: Facilitate successful ball movement during pressure situations by making space, receiving the ball, and either passing to a teammate or advancing towards the goal for a shot, based on defensive pressure and control over the ball.

target.info: Move to a wide-open position to make yourself available for a pass from a teammate under pressure.

nodes.info: Move to a wide-open position to make yourself available for a pass from a teammate under pressure.
nodes.termination: Stop when you are in a clear angle with respect to the teammate.

nodes.info: Receive the ball passed from the teammate.
nodes.termination: Stop when you have secure possession of the ball.

target.info: Move away from the opponent with the ball to either prepare for a through pass or to approach the goal for a shooting opportunity.

nodes.info: Move away from the opponent with the ball to either prepare for a through pass or to approach the goal for a shooting opportunity.
nodes.termination: Stop if there is a clear opportunity to pass or shoot.

nodes.info: Make a through pass to the teammate moving towards the goal.
nodes.termination: Stop upon successful execution of the pass.

nodes.info: Take a shot at the goal.

edges.condition: Teammate makes the pass to the open player.
Possession of the ball is secured.
In position to make a pass to the teammate.
The player has a clear opportunity to shoot.
